name: Cisco ASA — Large SMB Session (Pre-Encryption Data Staging)
xql_query:
dataset = cisco_asa_raw
| filter _raw_log contains "302014"
| alter scanner = _json -> generalCiscoLog.dst_ip,
        tgt_ip = _json -> generalCiscoLog.src_ip,
        svc_port = to_integer(_json -> generalCiscoLog.src_port),
        int_port = to_integer(_json -> generalCiscoLog.dst_port),
        proto    = _json -> generalCiscoLog.protocol,
        bytes_n = to_integer(_json -> generalCiscoLog.transferred_bytes)
| filter svc_port = 445 and bytes_n >= 100000000
| comp sum(bytes_n) as total_bytes,
       values(tgt_ip) as tgt_ips,
       values(int_port) as int_ports,
       values(proto) as protocols
       by scanner, svc_port
| filter total_bytes >= 100000000
| fields tgt_ips, int_ports, protocols, scanner, svc_port
description: ASA Teardown 302014 on src_port=445 with transferred_bytes ≥ 100MB — bulk SMB transfer indicating pre-encryption data staging.
alert_name: Cisco ASA — Large SMB Session (Pre-Encryption Data Staging)
